Review of the Nimbus 3 kettle

I bought this kettle two weeks ago. It boils water quickly, in about two minutes, and the blue light is a nice touch.

However, the lid is stiff and hard to open with one hand, and the handle gets warm. The cable is also quite short.

For 35 pounds I expected better build quality. I would not buy it again, although it does the basic job.

Rating: 2 out of 5 stars.
